title: What Shapes Pay Within a Range

Head_01.text: What Shapes Pay Within a Range

Impact_01.text: Two people in the same role can have different pay for entirely legitimate reasons

Impact_02.text: The range tells you about the role - not the person.

Impact_03.text: Individual factors determine where each person sits within it.

narration.text: Within a pay range, several factors shape exactly where an individual falls. Performance matters — but it's not the only factor. Two people in the same role can have different pay for entirely legitimate reasons. One may have been hired when market rates were different. One may have specialized skills the other doesn't have or may be working towards acquiring. One may have more years in the role with a sustained track record of strong performance. This is why a pay range tells you about the role, not the person. The range reflects where the role sits in the market; individual factors determine where each person sits within it.
